title: The window stays gold
topic: At Mesquite ISD east of Dallas, special education teachers use an AI tool built with Panorama Education that pulls student data and lights up blank template boxes, and teachers reported IEP drafting fell from up to three hours to about 45 minutes per student, while privacy advocates ask that families be told.
hook: Up to three hours. Per student.

treatment.logline: A Mesquite special education teacher gets her evening back because a tool pulls in the data and points at the boxes she missed, while every decision stays in her pen.
treatment.cold_open: After the last bell a teacher catches a toppling stack of student folders and drops one, fat and bulging, on her desk. Behind her the classroom window is gold, and the sun begins to slide.
treatment.turn: A national study finds AI drafted plans hold up in quality and still save time after teachers review them, and the vendor says licensed staff finalize every plan. The mailbox stays an open question.
treatment.button: She clicks off the lamp and walks out with the closed folder while the window is still gold, the sun barely moved from where it sat after the bell.

hero.name: the highlighter with a face
hero.why: a fat yellow highlighter with eyes and brows that pops out of the pencil cup and points its glow at blank boxes, then backs away from the eligibility stamp. It makes 'flags what you forgot, never makes it up' a picture, and no earlier film has drawn it.

states.state: stuffed, loose blank pages bulging out of it
open, three data streams pouring into one draft page
the draft inside with its forgotten boxes glowing yellow
closed, a yellow note on it, a green ribbon and check across it

scenes.vo: In Mesquite, just east of Dallas, a special education teacher opens one student's folder after the last bell.

draw.subject: the teacher
draw.action: catches a toppling stack of folders and drops one fat folder on the desk

draw.subject: the folder
draw.action: flops open and loose blank pages spill out across the desk

scenes.vo: Inside is the start of an IEP, the plan behind that student's special education services. Teachers there reported it took up to three hours. Per student.

draw.subject: a blank IEP page
draw.action: slides out of the folder and its six empty boxes pop into place

draw.subject: a student at a desk
draw.action: looks up from a worksheet as a dashed line runs from the student to the blank plan
draw.emotion: the student grins, the teacher nods

draw.subject: the sun in the window
draw.action: slides down from gold to orange to a deep blue night, then whips back to gold
draw.emotion: the teacher slumps lower in the lamp light

draw.subject: a stack of blank IEP pages
draw.action: towers up beside the desk, one page per student, and teeters

scenes.vo: The district runs fifty two campuses with over thirty six thousand students, so those hours stack up fast.

draw.subject: the school bus
draw.action: pulls away from the school marquee as the bell clangs
draw.emotion: a teacher waves it off from the door

draw.subject: fifty two school pins
draw.action: rain down across a map of the district and each one sprouts a little stack of folders

scenes.vo: So the district built a tool with Panorama Education. It's called Solara.

draw.subject: the highlighter
draw.action: pops out of the pencil cup, blinks and stretches

draw.subject: the laptop
draw.action: flips open and its screen wakes with a soft glow as the highlighter hops on top

scenes.vo: It pulls a student's data from district platforms. Academic data, attendance and behavior pour into one draft.

draw.subject: three app tiles
draw.action: slam down on the desk and pipes snake out of them toward the folder

draw.subject: three streams of data chips
draw.action: pour through the pipes into the open folder and a draft page rises out of it

scenes.vo: From that data, it drafts the student's present levels of achievement.

draw.subject: the top two boxes of the draft page
draw.action: fill with typed lines one after the other as data chips drop in

scenes.vo: It can flag a trend, like attendance slipping, or a subject where the child is struggling.

draw.subject: an attendance line
draw.action: draws on across the laptop screen and dips sharply

visual_events.at_phrase: a subject where the child is struggling
visual_events.label: Struggling subject

draw.subject: the highlighter
draw.action: taps a sinking math grade bar and a yellow ring blooms around it

scenes.vo: It was trained on an IEP template, so it lights up the boxes a teacher may have forgotten, instead of making things up.

draw.subject: the highlighter
draw.action: swings its glow across the page and two empty boxes light up yellow with a question mark

draw.subject: the teacher
draw.action: smacks her forehead, grins and writes into the glowing box herself

scenes.vo: It won't dictate what help a student needs. It doesn't decide eligibility either. Teachers stay the main drivers of the plan.

draw.subject: three help cards
draw.action: fan toward the highlighter, which shakes its cap no and pushes them to the teacher

draw.subject: an ELIGIBILITY rubber stamp
draw.action: slides at the highlighter, which backs away and nudges it into the teacher's hand

draw.subject: the teacher
draw.action: lifts the stamp and thumps it down on the page

scenes.vo: Over eleven months, teachers reported the drafting fell from up to three hours to about forty five minutes per student.

draw.subject: the left window
draw.action: runs the sun all the way down into night as a three hour arc draws on

draw.subject: the right window
draw.action: moves its sun only a quarter of the way and stops, still gold
draw.emotion: the teacher throws both arms up

scenes.vo: Nationally, a 2025 study found AI drafted plans matched teacher written ones in quality, and still saved time after teachers reviewed them.

draw.subject: a balance scale
draw.action: takes an AI drafted plan and a teacher written plan, wobbles and settles level

draw.subject: both plans on the scale
draw.action: get a green check mark stamped on them

draw.subject: two stopwatches
draw.action: race side by side and the AI plan's watch clicks to a stop well short of the teacher plan's

scenes.vo: Not everyone is comfortable. Privacy advocate Amelia Vance warns that the more places information sits, the more places it can be breached from.

draw.subject: copies of the student's page
draw.action: fly out of the laptop into a row of lockers, each with a shield lock on its door

draw.subject: a quote card
draw.action: slams onto the locker row reading MORE PLACES IT SITS

draw.subject: the last shield lock
draw.action: cracks with a red line as the row of shields wobbles

scenes.vo: She would tell families up front and let them opt out. Mesquite sent no separate notice, saying the tool supports work the district already does.

draw.subject: a dashed ghost letter with an opt out box
draw.action: floats down toward a family's mailbox

draw.subject: the parent
draw.action: opens the mailbox and finds it empty while the ghost letter fades

scenes.vo: Panorama says licensed staff still review, revise and finalize every plan. The folder closes before the sun goes down.

draw.subject: the teacher
draw.action: signs the bottom of the page while the highlighter sits capped beside it

draw.subject: the folder
draw.action: snaps shut with a yellow note and a green check as the teacher clicks off the lamp and walks out into gold light

shots.at_phrase: a subject where the child is struggling
